mapper.sql: c.eval_id AS committeeId, c.tender_id AS tenderId, t.tender_name AS tenderName, CONCAT('ROUND-', c.round_no) AS committeeCode, CONCAT('第', c.round_no, '轮评标') AS committeeName, c.stage_code AS evaluationMethod, NULL AS evaluationLocation, c.eval_time AS evaluationStartTime, c.eval_time AS evaluationEndTime, c.result AS status, NULL AS evaluationDirectorName, c.evaluator_user_id AS evaluationDirectorId, NULL AS supervisorName, NULL AS supervisorId, NULL AS createdByName, c.evaluator_user_id AS createdBy, c.eval_time AS createdTime
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM exp_tender_evaluation c LEFT JOIN exp_tender t ON c.tender_id = t.tender_id WHERE c.eval_id = #{committeeId}

SELECT
FROM exp_tender_evaluation c LEFT JOIN exp_tender t ON c.tender_id = t.tender_id WHERE c.tender_id = #{tenderId} AND CONCAT('ROUND-', c.round_no) = #{committeeCode} ORDER BY c.eval_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM exp_tender_evaluation c LEFT JOIN exp_tender t ON c.tender_id = t.tender_id WHERE c.tender_id = #{tenderId} ORDER BY c.eval_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exp_tender_evaluation ( tender_id, bid_id, round_no, stage_code, stage_name, result, evaluator_user_id, eval_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{req.tenderId}, NULL, #{roundNo}, #{req.evaluationMethod}, #{req.committeeName}, #{status}, #{evaluatorUserId}, #{evalTime}, #{req.remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE exp_tender_evaluation SET round_no = #{roundNo}, stage_code = #{req.evaluationMethod}, stage_name = #{req.committeeName}, result = #{status}, evaluator_user_id = #{req.evaluationDirectorId}, eval_time = #{evalTime}, remark = #{req.remark} WHERE eval_id = #{committeeId}
